d:
A rare and unique archival informal video footage from a Concert at The Royal Festival Hall, London featuring one sequence from the crossover works composed by Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia and Pablo Cueco, leading L'Orchestre Transes Europennes.
The excerpt here, SANDHYA SHREE is inspired by the evening melody Raga Puriya Kalyan.
The entire concert recording from the premiere performance (Feb 1999) at the Theatre de la Ville, Paris is available on Navras CD ADI ANANT -Creation Mondiale (NRCD 6002). Shubhankar Banerjee accompanies Panditji and the Orchestra on Tabla.
